title: Hula 7000 Raspberry Chew Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: The Hula 7000 Raspberry Chew Prefilled pod offers the juicy sweetness of ripe Raspberry with a confectionery-inspired edge. Its flavour evokes the playful taste of classic chewy sweets, delivering a sugary berry vape that remains light enough for all-day enjoyment. Made for the Hula Prefilled Pod System Kit, these replacement pods give you a clean, straightforward way to switch flavours. Each pod holds 2ml of 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid, automatically replenished from a built-in 10ml refill reservoir so you can forget about manual top-ups or coil replacements. With up to 7000 puffs (approx.) per pod, dual mesh coil technology ensures the Raspberry Chew flavour stays consistent and satisfying. Insert into your Hula device and enjoy a sweet berry vape with minimal fuss. Available in 20 satisfying flavours, these replacement pods are perfect for keeping your vape fresh and flavourful.
